Zapata Computing is facing opposition from its shareholders over proposed corporate actions.  Shareholders have reportedly stalled governance changes and a planned reverse stock split, raising concerns about the company's ability to complete these initiatives.  The situation highlights tension between management’s strategic plans and shareholder interests.
